text: The CEO of MegaCorp likes to talk about corporate responsibility, but this is the man who laid off 10,000 workers while giving himself a $25 million bonus. His new sustainability initiative is nothing more than a PR campaign designed to distract from the company's continued dumping of industrial waste into the river. Sometimes you have to look at who is speaking, not just what they are saying.

annotations.quote: this is the man who laid off 10,000 workers while giving himself a $25 million bonus
the company's continued dumping of industrial waste into the river

metadata.note: The speaker raises a genuine hypocrisy — the CEO's past actions are relevant to evaluating the sincerity of a sustainability initiative. The waste dumping is directly related to the sustainability claim, not a true red herring. However, pointing to character and past behavior rather than the merits of the initiative itself has the structure of ad hominem reasoning.
